positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed scalable full stack applications using Angular, Node.js, and REST APIs, with a strong focus on security and performance, and deployed them on Azure K8s using GitHub Actions for continuous integration and deployment.
Architected and developed scalable microservices using Node.js, GraphQL, and MongoDB, with a focus on event driven architecture and continuous deployment using Azure K8s and GitHub Actions, resulting in a 30% increase in system uptime and a 25% reduction in latency.
Extensive cloud and container experience deploying services on AWS, GCP, PCF, OpenShift, and GKE using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and Serverless Framework.
Strong DevOps and CI/CD expertise with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Cloud Build, Nexus, Git, SVN, and Docker automation, improving delivery efficiency and deployment reliability.
Database and data engineering experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DB2, Oracle, JDBC, Spring Data, replication, backups, performance tuning, and Spark (Scala, Spark SQL) pipelines.
Worked with observability and monitoring tools (CloudWatch, ELK stack) to track system health, create dashboards, and perform root cause analysis in distributed systems.
Event streaming and real time data processing using Kafka, AWS Lambda, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, SNS, SQS, HDFS, and BigQuery for analytics and operational workloads.
Designed and developed scalable backend services using Node.js and Express, exposing REST APIs and integrating with Kafka based event streams.
Developed and optimized BigQuery based data pipelines for analytics workloads. Improved system reliability and uptime by implementing health checks, retries, and fault tolerant design patterns.
Test automation and quality engineering using Playwright, Karate, Cucumber (BDD), Jest, React Native Testing Library, and Agile practices (Scrum, TDD, BDD).
Performance optimization and troubleshooting expertise using JVM profiling, multithreading, Executor Service, log analysis, CloudWatch monitoring, and root cause analysis.
Implemented authentication, validation, and rate limiting using API Gateway and OAuth2.
Built API first microservices with Node.js and Python supporting state transitions and business rule processing.
Security and compliance experience implementing OAuth 2.0, RBAC, IAM, Google Secret Manager, secure API design, XML/JSON validation, and enterprise security standards.
Leadership and SDLC ownership, including design reviews, mentoring engineers, cross team collaboration, incident response, and end to end delivery of highly available enterprise systems.
Developed and optimized MongoDB databases for high performance data storage and retrieval, and integrated them with Node.js and GraphQL APIs for real time data processing and analytics.
Implemented Akamai setup for content delivery and caching, resulting in a 40% reduction in page load times and a 20% increase in user engagement, and integrated it with Azure K8s for seamless deployment and management.
Technical leadership and collaboration, leading architecture reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and partnering with product, DevOps, and operations teams to deliver reliable enterprise platforms.
Designed and implemented Linux/Unix shell scripts for automated deployment and management of Azure K8s clusters, resulting in a 50% reduction in deployment time and a 30% increase in system reliability.

Strong DevOps and CI/CD expertise with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Cloud Build, Nexus, Git, SVN, and Docker automation, improving delivery efficiency and deployment reliability.
